map.登山海拔适应时间表适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Altitude Acclimatization Schedule best for?
map.根据目标海拔生成逐日上升计划，评估高原反应风险等级: Generate a day-by-day ascent plan from the target altitude and assess altitude-sickness risk level
map.高原适应遵循「爬得慢、睡得低」原则：每日住宿海拔上升建议 ≤ 300–500 m: Altitude acclimatization follows the "climb high, sleep low" principle: daily sleeping-altitude gain should be <= 300-500 m, and every cumulative 1,000 m gain warrants 1 acclimatization day; use the Lake Louise score (headache/fatigue/dizziness/insomnia/GI) to assess acute mountain sickness (AMS) risk — a score >= 3 means descend.
map.（<2500m）：一般无反应，轻微气短: (<2500 m): usually no symptoms, slight breathlessness
map.（2500-3500m）：可能出现轻微头痛、失眠、食欲下降: (2500-3500 m): mild headache, insomnia, and loss of appetite may occur
map.（3500-5500m）：需严格适应计划，警惕急性高山病(AMS): (3500-5500 m): a strict acclimatization plan is needed; watch for acute mountain sickness (AMS)
map.（5500-7000m）：严重缺氧风险，需专业保障: (5500-7000 m): severe hypoxia risk; professional support required
map.（>7000m）：人体无法长期适应，仅限专业登山: (>7000 m): the body cannot adapt long-term; for professional mountaineering only
map.海拔超过3000m后，每上升300m增加至少1天适应: Above 3,000 m, add at least 1 acclimatization day for every 300 m climbed
map.每上升1000m建议增加1个休息日: Add 1 rest day for every 1,000 m of ascent
map.睡觉海拔不应比前一天高超过300-500m: Sleeping altitude should not exceed the previous day's by more than 300-500 m
map.出现严重头痛、呕吐、意识模糊应立即下撤: Severe headache, vomiting, or confusion means descend immediately
map.高原攀登前规划适应，防急性高山病。: Plan acclimatization before a high-altitude climb to prevent acute mountain sickness.
map.登山按起止海拔排适应日程，每日净爬升控在 300–500 m 以防急性高原病。: Schedule acclimatization by starting and target altitude, keeping daily net ascent at 300-500 m to prevent AMS.
map.每升 1000 m 安排 1–3 天适应；3500 m 以上每日净爬升建议 ≤3: Allow 1-3 acclimatization days per 1,000 m of gain; above 3,500 m, keep daily net ascent to <=300-500 m, following the descending sleeping-altitude principle.
map.睡眠在较低海拔利于恢复，降低夜间低氧应激。: Sleeping at a lower altitude aids recovery and reduces nocturnal hypoxic stress.
map.适应慢能硬上更高海拔吗？: Can I push to higher altitude despite slow acclimatization?
map.硬上易诱发 AMS 甚至高原肺水肿，出现头痛、恶心、呕吐应下撤而非继续上升，药物: Forcing it can trigger AMS or even high-altitude pulmonary edema; with headache, nausea, or vomiting, descend rather than continue up — medication is only an aid.
